verdict.rationale: uv is a locally installed CLI rather than a hosted service, so the core product runs on the user's own machines. It is installable via standalone installers, curl, pip, or package managers across macOS, Linux, and Windows, and a hands-on report describes it working on a restricted shared server without root. Users also publish to internal GitLab registries with `uv build`/`uv publish`. missing for 10: explicit evidence of an open-source license or source availability for building from source, documentation of fully offline/air-gapped operation independent of Astral or PyPI infrastructure.
